en: The image is a black and white photograph of a church surrounded by a churchyard with gravestones. The church is a white building with a square bell tower on the left and round-arched windows. There are some trees and a pathway leading up to the main entrance of the church. The lower left corner contains the caption: 'Ödeborgs kyrka.' and the lower right corner contains publishing information.
